name: glossy-photo-graffiti-scrawl
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: glossy high-resolution magazine-cover photograph, extreme tight face crop, then defaced with hand-drawn graphic overlays.
· PHOTO LAYER: crisp studio flash, wet-glossy lips and chrome-blue wraparound sunglasses with mirrored reflections, jewel-encrusted tooth gems, leather-gloved hand.

· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: rough cobalt-blue spray-paint blobs and torn shapes stamped over the image, plus scribbled neon acid-green marker doodles — stars, hearts, lightning scrawls — like graffiti on a poster.
· PALETTE: fiery scarlet-red hair, electric cobalt-blue paint, toxic lime-green scribbles, warm skin tones.
· CONTRAST: punchy saturated photo underneath fighting against flat matte hand-drawn marks on top.
· MOOD: brash, chaotic, pop-punk maximalist collage energy.
· TEXTURE: clean glossy print grain under the gritty spray and pen strokes.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
